fusions.name: Spindle Shoal
fusions.desc: Looses a shoal of 4 thread-trailing spindles in a wide fan, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Weighted Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a weighted line at an enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.4 times as much at full reach, and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Oiled Selvage
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% and your dodge chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Fumbled Catch
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 50%, you slip free and gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
